fixture_metadata.title: A Manual of HuyNQ — Guide to Working & Collaborating

slides.title: Working with HuyNQ — A User Manual
slides.subtitle: A practical guide on how to work, communicate, and collaborate with me

core_values.name: Integrity
core_values.description: Radical transparency, honesty, and doing what is right even when difficult.

core_values.name: Winning Mindset
core_values.description: High standards, drive to solve tough problems, and commitment to meaningful outcomes.

core_values.name: Continuous improvement
core_values.description: Constant iteration, learning from mistakes, and incremental daily gains.

driving_philosophy.title: Build & Discover Simultaneously
driving_philosophy.description: Prefers running discovery concurrently while building products, rather than waiting for fully baked ideas.

slides.title: How We Connect — Communication Preferences & Rules

preferred_channels.best_for: Best for non-mentally taxing and quick info exchange.
Best for complex or easily misunderstood topics.
Best for official decisions or third-party communications.

boundaries: Context upfront: Context provided upfront unless mutual understanding is established.
One at a time: Only handle one face-to-face or live call conversation at a time.

key_content.preferred_channel: Face-to-face (does not matter if private or public)

feedback_structure.title: Shared Understanding of Impact
feedback_structure.detail: Establishing a shared understanding of the problem and its impact on the business, product, or team.

slides.title: Inside the Engine — Default Behaviors & Quirks

default_behaviors.name: Out-Loud Brainstorming
default_behaviors.behavior: Brainstorm and jump between ideas out loud before focusing on the final solution.

default_behaviors.name: Coherence-Driven
default_behaviors.behavior: Easily get irritated when things get incoherent, and tend to sort them out before moving on.

default_behaviors.name: Topic-Selective Energy
default_behaviors.behavior: More energetic when discussing product and engineering topics; lower energy in other areas.

default_behaviors.name: Build & Discover
default_behaviors.behavior: Love to build and run product discovery at the same time.

slides.title: Debugging Huy — Known Issues & Support Plan

bugs.issue: Ask a lot of questions when a problem is not fully understood before committing.
bugs.support: Provide clear context and explain how it is relevant to the business, product, or team.

bugs.issue: Respond slowly when running on low energy.
bugs.support: Give time to recover, still feel free to ask for faster response if urgent.

bugs.issue: Tend to be incoherent when getting over-excited.
bugs.support: Give time to let things sink in, and echo back what you hear if possible.

bugs.issue: Sometimes push self and people too hard.
bugs.support: Explain if it's not working or if energy is better spent in other ways.

slides.title: Rules of Engagement — Pet Peeves & Golden Rules

pet_peeves: Refusal of ideas or proposals without clear reasons.
golden_rules: Notify me beforehand for synchronous check-ins.
Give reasons for idea/proposal refusal, and optionally suggest alternatives.

slides.title: Conclusion — Let's Build Useful Things Together

cheatsheet_summary: Support the bugs (echo back, tag urgency, protect energy)
Respect focus time (pre-notify check-ins, explain rejections)
key_content.closing_quote: This manual is a living document—let's keep communicating, building, and improving together!
